audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagrees with the already-audited mirror (kayle__warwick), which corrected the chart to Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle. This page reads Warwick, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Warwick, Kayle, Kayle — four rows in conflict. diff also reads HARD while diffRating is 4/10, tone is the green token and report[14] says 'Favoured'.
audit.why: Two directions of the same matchup must not contradict, and mirror-fix.js would overwrite these rows anyway. 54.73% winrate with a hard early lead and a hard late fall matches the mirror's shape.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 aligned to the mirror on both layers as one matched group, ratings adjusted, diff set to FAV so it agrees with the 4/10 rating and the final-rating line.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere (packet reports zero sequencing cues), and the level-6 spike text is written as if Warwick wins that window.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 dropping to 80s at rank 3 — an enormous window when it is down and the single most punishable cooldown in the matchup. Kayle's real scaling spikes are her passive range breakpoints plus items, not a defensive item.
audit.corrected: Put the 160s number into the level-6 phase and kept the spike windows otherwise intact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors: Infinite Duress is described as a 'point-and-click fight starter' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late; and Kayle's kiting slow is attributed to E in spikes[3].text and the late prose.
audit.why: Riot's text: Warwick leaps in a direction and suppresses the FIRST champion he collides with for 1.5s — directional and missable. Kayle's E, Starfire Spellblade, is an auto-attack reset dealing missing-health damage with no slow; the slow lives on Q, Radiant Blast (900 range, 12s at rank 1 falling to 8s at rank 5), which also shreds resistances.
audit.corrected: R restated as a directional leap; the slow reassigned to Radiant Blast with its real cooldown.

audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal on herself and the nearest ally, so the existing Executioner's Calling recommendation is genuinely earned rather than boilerplate.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kayle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is invulnerability on a 160s cooldown at rank 1. Infinite Duress leaps onto the first champion in its path, so bait her R before spending it.

edits.before: At 6 you suppress or bait her Divine Judgment for a kill.
edits.after: At 6 Divine Judgment invulnerability blanks your all-in.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool — build your teamfight around that. Kayle carry threat: 9.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Infinite Duress leaps onto the first champion it collides with for a 1.5s suppress — line it up, it can miss. Kayle carry threat: 9.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control once she scales.

edits.before: Once Kayle hits her level-11 and item spike she out-ranges everything you have, kites with E slow, and her R saves her from your dive — she becomes unkillable, so end early.
edits.after: Once Kayle hits her level-11 and item spike she out-ranges everything you have, kites with Radiant Blast's slow (8s at rank 5), and her R saves her from your dive — so end early.

edits.before: Late Kayle inverts the matchup completely: ranged auto-attacks, E slow kiting, and R invulnerability mean you cannot touch her, so your entire game plan is to snowball a lead and close before she comes online.
edits.after: Late Kayle inverts the matchup completely: ranged auto-attacks, Radiant Blast slow kiting, and R invulnerability mean you cannot touch her, so your entire game plan is to snowball a lead and close before she comes online.

notes: Left untouched on purpose, same as the mirror auditor: spikes[1].text says you can 'wait out the immunity' under your ult and the mid prose says you 'suppress her before Divine Judgment'. Whether Divine Judgment's invulnerability prevents or survives Infinite Duress' suppression is not answerable from the kit files — invulnerability normally blanks damage, not CC — so I did not rewrite those strings. Also note the page refers to Kayle as 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, dontsFull and several report entries; those are pronoun-only defects I did not spend edits on.
